question: Surat is also known as ______ of India.
solution:
The Correct Answer is **Diamond city** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Surat is famous for its diamond cutting and polishing and is known as the Diamond City of India.
 
• **90%** of **all diamond cutting** and **polishing** on the **planet takes place in Surat.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points:__**

__
 
• Surat is a port city situated on the banks of the Tapi River.
